change: Explicit developer example generates deterministic paired built-in transform/decoder fan-out documents. No production widget, application, node-feature, runtime, or routing change.
measurement_context: Sequential 100-node then 500-node native runs. Source fixed, no concurrent Cargo validation. Actual WGPU/Metal application UI, continuous repaint, fresh default panel layout, 100% graph zoom and initial pan, no capture loaded or viewer outputs selected. Thirty valid previous-frame CPU observations warm the UI, then 120 samples. No interaction or graph execution. Real controls, shapes, socket counts and shared-output fan-out differ from the neutral paired-grid-v1 CPU benchmark, which uses 35% zoom; results cannot be subtracted to isolate GPU cost or used as a before/after optimization comparison. UI-start intervals include host scheduling/pacing and are not presentation latency. Timing reports retain input document counts. Generator checks exact wires and node counts after editor load; tests check deterministic bytes, positions, allocation counters and complete serialized reload equality. No route fallback/collision/smoothing-quality assertions or live execution validation.
rejected_preliminary_fixture: Repeating synthetic capture sources produced source-discovery conflicts and legacy viewer migration toasts; those timings are not accepted or pooled. The retained workload has no capture sources and explicitly deselects every output using the current UI document contract.
